title: Minesweeper Duel
description: Compete with friends one-on-one online. Play for free against computer. Minesweeper Duel is a new mode for the game familiar from childhood for the mind and logic In a one-on-one competition, you open the cells in turn with your opponent and get points equal to the face value of the open cell. The player with the highest score wins. The player who stumbles upon a mine loses immediately. Available field sizes: - Newbie - Amateur - Professional Time for thinking is limited, choose different modes: - The bullet - Blitz - Classic
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
